Three prior attempts that reshuffled that ladder all landed at exactly cost 3549, so the remaining cost is probably in the per-word work: the `xs[i]` bounds checks and the `OnesCount64` calls. Behavior is unchanged, and the function still never writes to `xs`. Whether giri counts those checks as SSA instructions is unverified, so the gain is speculative.
